Loading the data, packages 

```{r}

library(multiverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(lme4)



my_data = read_csv("C:/ELTE_ST/Additional_research_activity/gamedev/Schweinsberg/data/edge1.1.csv")
game = multiverse()


particip_data_duplicates = my_data |> 
  dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters)|> 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor,  ~ paste(unique(.x), collapse = "; "))) 
        
 particip_data_filt = particip_data_duplicates |>
  filter(if_any(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, ~ grepl(";", .x)))
 
 my_data = anti_join(my_data, particip_data_filt,  by = c("ThreadId", "Id"))
 
 particip_data_clean = my_data |> 
   dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters)|> 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique))

my_data_n = my_data |> 
  group_by(ThreadId) |> 
  dplyr::select(!Live) |> 
  summarise(across(Male_Contributions:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique))


```



Attempt on trying a data_filtering decision with the multiverse 

```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}
my_data_st1 = my_data |> 
  dplyr::select(branch(level, 
                       "participant" ~ !c(Order:Number.Characters), 
                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) |> 
  group_by(ThreadId, branch(level, 
                  "participant" ~ Id, 
                  "conversation" ~ NULL)) |> 
  summarise(branch(level, 
                          "participant" ~ across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique),
                          "conversation" ~ across(Male_Contributions:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))


parameters(game)

```


```{r}
execute_multiverse(game, progress = TRUE)

```
